Each admissible word is realizable by picking its levels in increasing indices, with all intermediate clusters given a color of the next palette. Finite modal distinguishability lets one define every subset of these types, yielding exactly 2^E distinct operation tables. The quantifiers include r=0, h=1 and nonuniform capacities. final_claim: For every fixed finite reflexive linear-preorder frame with ordered cluster sizes a_i and every r>=0, the number of r-ary Boolean-modal term operations is 2^E, where E sums the first palette sizes over the capacity-admissible suffix-reduced palette words on 2^r colors; singleton chain E=q sum_{j=0}^{h-1}(q-1)^j.
limitations: Only finite reflexive linearly preordered Kripke frames and unimodal ordinary Boolean operation clone; no formula-length or complexity optimality theorem.
